reasoning_content: I'm checking the Dex login page structure to understand how it handles the back parameter and CSRF tokens, and whether the state parameter is properly encoded in the form action.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
grep -o '<form[^>]*>' dex_auth2.html
grep -o '<input[^>]*type="hidden"[^>]*>' dex_auth2.html
grep -o '<input[^>]*name="login"[^>]*>' dex_auth2.html
grep -o '<input[^>]*name="password"[^>]*>' dex_auth2.html
